'''Yarma''' was a [[planet]] in the [[Yarma system]]<ref name="Steps" /> within the [[Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> where [[Reklam Station]], an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[salvage yard]], was located. In [[2 BBY]], a [[Mission to Reklam Station|mission]] was undertaken by members of [[Phoenix Cell]] to steal a [[squadron]] of [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] [[starfighter]]s for their [[fleet]].<ref name="Steps" />
